name: Ashland University
academic_ranking: Private Christian university (affiliated with The Brethren Church), founded 1878. Master's-level institution offering 60+ majors across four colleges plus a graduate school and theological seminary. Ranked #37 among Regional Universities Midwest by U.S. News & World Report (2025), with a 13:1 student-faculty ratio and roughly 80% of faculty holding terminal degrees.
financial_aid: According to U.S. News (2025), 99% of first-time, full-time freshmen receive some kind of financial aid; Ashland ranked #36 in Best Value Schools (2025). Exact tuition figure not confirmed from a primary source during research (2026-07); university tuition pages returned 404 and aggregators were inaccessible.
facilities_notes: Softball competes as part of Ashland Eagles athletics. Specific softball facility details (home field/complex) not confirmed from a fetched primary source during research (2026-07).
program_reputation: NCAA Division II women's softball program competing in the Great Midwest Athletic Conference (G-MAC), which Ashland joined in the 2021-22 academic year. Detailed win/loss history and national ranking not confirmed from fetched sources during research.
notes: Data collected 2026-07 from goashlandeagles.com. 2026 roster shows 27 players (roster page). Coaching staff sourced from official staff directory (softball-department/8): head coach Jackie Price and assistant coach Lane Leedy; no other softball staff members listed. No public emails, phone numbers, or Twitter/X handles were listed in the staff directory (email/phone links were empty placeholders). Tuition and scholarship count set to null because they could not be verified from a reliable primary source.
